RULE.statement: RULED AT K1 (Matt, 2026-09-12; amends V1a): the STARTER set carries NO insignia — no ring, no hour-mark, no shape on the tabard chest, and no head-piece atop the staff; every surface is plain and undecorated. The single open ring with one radial hour-mark is RESERVED as an earned ADVANCED-set motif (placements to be ruled with the advanced set). Placement counts are maximum budgets: starter = 0 everywhere.

RULE.statement: RULED V3(a), tightened at K1: the STARTER set has ZERO motif placements — everything is plain planes; wear and stitching only at fasteners and load points.
RULE.status: RULED 2026-09-12 (V3a); O4 plain_fraction threshold calibrated at K2 from the approved master

RULE.statement: RULED V2: materials — ivory linen shirt · navy wool tabard and trousers · chestnut leather harness strap, belt, bracers, boots · OLIVE WAXED-CANVAS satchel with brass corners · DARK WALNUT staff with small brass ferrules (no ring head on the starter) · white-lacquered plate with gold trim (advanced set only) · dark curly hair. Rule: no two adjacent parts share a hue bin (machine-legible costume; O6 classifies parts in CIELAB a*b*). Deliberately unmeasured: face, hair highlights. Neutrals (white plate vs iron) accepted as inseparable — never adjacent in the S-idle base. a*b* windows below are PROVISIONAL and are re-measured from the approved K1 master.
RULE.status: RULED 2026-09-12 (V2 incl. sub-forks i, ii, iii); windows calibrated at K1

RULE.statement: RULED V4 (spec over reference on both sub-forks): every strap terminates at a named part; every fastener closes a named gap; belt count = 1 (one waist belt, its buckle closes the tabard); harness = ONE diagonal strap, shoulder → opposite hip, carrying the satchel on the figure's LEFT hip; the astrolabe-rod is held in the RIGHT hand; pauldron asymmetry only on the advanced set (LEFT shoulder, oversized). The F04 anchors' X-harness and doubled waist band are the known-bad. AMENDED AT K1 (Matt 2026-09-12): the staff is a plain dark walnut shaft with small brass ferrules at foot and tip — NO ring head, no shape atop it; rod_head is ABSENT on the starter set (present=false) and returns only if the advanced set earns it.
RULE.status: RULED 2026-09-12 (V4 i: spec; ii: spec); O9 part-inventory + controls calibrated (R-9)

style.sentence: HAND-DRAWN painted 2D in the manner of a modern hand-animated action game — a confident dark contour line drawn by hand with visible taper and varying weight, painted fills in clean planes inside the line, restrained texture; the line carries the pose. It should look like one frame of hand-drawn animation, not a rendered illustration.
